 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
 block.
This 
 pump is used to sodium hypochlorite injection into pipe after the two filter 
 to the potable water construction tank .
The 
 first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
 inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified 
 by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Sodium hypochlorite dosing Pumps | P-502A/B
MANUFACTUR | OBL
MODEL | MD 2,4 P DV FA Z92 M3052
PUMP TYPE | Spring return mechanism mechanical diaphragm 
 metering pump . mechanism and gearbox enclosed in an oil bath lubricated 
 anodized aluminum casing. double ball valve
Reagent availability | Sodium hypochlorite solution
Quantity | 2(1Duty /1 Standby)
Pump capacity & duty | 2 L/H
Max. pressure | 10 bar
Strokes per minute | 70
Head | 100 M
SPEED | 1450 R.P.M CW
El motor power | 0.37 KW
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump
Check the level of oil
Check the pump leaks
Pump out of operation
Adjust oil level
Check the bolts fixation
Adjust the pump and piping for leaks
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps 
should be checked
Open suction and delivery valve
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting ; 
 it is clockwise
Attendance 
and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be checked:
Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power
Check the water leakage of pump
Check the pump noise
